I can't give you an amount for vitamin D, or any supplement. That one's for a doctor or a registered dietitian. Vitamin D is also something a blood test can speak to, so they can tell you whether you need it at all and how much is right for you.

In general terms, it's not a training supplement. It matters for the body overall, and most people get some from sun and food. The training basics matter far more: lifting consistently, eating enough protein, and sleeping well.

Want me to look at your training week, or build you a session?
